policy.verification_policy: Nutrition values remain separate from feeding verdicts. verified means the stored record identity (scientific name or Korean standard food name, plant part, raw state) and every stored nutrient value were reconciled against the named official downloadable dataset: USDA FoodData Central (SR Legacy JSON 2018-04 / Foundation JSON 2026-04-30) the RDA Korean standard food composition data, the MEXT Standard Tables of Food Composition in Japan (8th rev., 2023 supplement) the Indian Food Composition Tables 2017 (ICMR-NIN) or the German Nutrient Database BLS 4.0 (MRI). Values are never estimated, averaged across records, or borrowed from a congener, a different plant part, or a non-raw state; unmatched plants are listed in data/nutrition_hold_list_v1.json.
policy.note_ko: 영양성분 수치만으로 육지거북의 급여 안전성·권장 빈도·식단 비율을 판정하지 않는다. 식품 성분값은 품종·재배·분석 조건에 따라 달라질 수 있다.

plants.dataset_release: Mlcek J, Plaskova A, Jurikova T, Sochor J, Baron M, Ercisli S. Chemical, Nutritional and Sensory Characteristics of Six Ornamental Edible Flowers Species. Foods. 2021;10(9):2053. Full text XML via Europe PMC (PMC8472405).
plants.basis: per 100 g fresh flower mass (published mg/kg FM divided by 10)
plants.sample: Whole fresh flowers harvested at full bloom from five plants per cultivar, pooled, puréed within 24 h; five replicates per year; values are the two-year mean (n = 10).
plants.sampling_location: Experimental orchards of Mendel University in Brno, Lednice, Czech Republic (unheated greenhouse, 170 m a.s.l.)
plants.identity_match_basis: PMC8472405 species/cultivar table: Calendula officinalis 'Orange King' = master taxon Calendula officinalis (exact species)
plants.applicability_note_ko: 체코 유리온실 재배 관상용 품종 'Orange King'의 생화(꽃 전체) 분석값(2년 평균, n=10)이다. 잎·줄기에는 적용하지 않으며, 품종·재배 토양에 따라 무기질 함량이 달라질 수 있다.
plants.feeding_scope_note_ko: 성분 기술용 자료이며 급여 등급·빈도·안전성 판정에 사용하지 않는다.
plants.value_conventions: Minerals published as mg/kg fresh mass and crude protein as g/kg FM (Kjeldahl N × 6.25) were divided by 10. Water was not measured as such and is not derived; dry matter (% w/w) is stored as published. Fibre, vitamin C and energy were not measured and are absent, not zero.
